product.name: Nikon Z50II
product.disclaimerZh: 内部结构为参考性重建，非 Nikon 制造商原始 CAD 数据。
product.disclaimerEn: Internal structures are reference reconstruction and not Nikon manufacturer CAD.

modules.nameZh: 电子取景器与顶部闪光灯

parts.descriptionZh: 具有圆柱头和十字槽的机壳紧固件；六枚螺钉共享同一网格数据。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell fastener with cylindrical head and cross recess; all six screws share one mesh datablock.

parts.descriptionZh: 与同组紧固件链接网格、但保留独立选择ID和装配座标的机壳螺钉。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell screw linked to the shared fastener mesh while retaining its own selectable ID and seat coordinate.

parts.descriptionZh: 与同组紧固件链接网格、但保留独立选择ID和装配座标的机壳螺钉。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell screw linked to the shared fastener mesh while retaining its own selectable ID and seat coordinate.

parts.descriptionZh: 与同组紧固件链接网格、但保留独立选择ID和装配座标的机壳螺钉。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell screw linked to the shared fastener mesh while retaining its own selectable ID and seat coordinate.

parts.descriptionZh: 与同组紧固件链接网格、但保留独立选择ID和装配座标的机壳螺钉。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell screw linked to the shared fastener mesh while retaining its own selectable ID and seat coordinate.

parts.descriptionZh: 与同组紧固件链接网格、但保留独立选择ID和装配座标的机壳螺钉。
parts.descriptionEn: Shell screw linked to the shared fastener mesh while retaining its own selectable ID and seat coordinate.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入底壳止口并具有铰轴和锁扣缺口的参考舱门。
parts.descriptionEn: Inset reference battery door with hinge barrel and latch notch.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入上接口门洞并带铰链与锁扣缺口的柔性门。
parts.descriptionEn: Flexible door seated in the upper port opening with hinge and latch reveal.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入下接口门洞并带铰链与锁扣缺口的柔性门。
parts.descriptionEn: Flexible door seated in the lower port opening with hinge and latch reveal.

parts.descriptionZh: 六枚与机壳螺钉座对应的独立环形垫圈组成一个选择组。
parts.descriptionEn: Selectable set of six annular washers corresponding to the six shell-screw seats.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入握柄顶肩凹座的快门释放按钮参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference shutter release seated in the grip-shoulder pocket.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入机背凹座并带径向拨杆的照片／视频选择器。
parts.descriptionEn: Rear recessed photo/video selector with a radial lever.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于独立前壳沉孔中的Fn1功能按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: Fn1 function button seated in a dedicated front-shell bore.

parts.descriptionZh: 预留Z卡口旁沉孔中的镜头释放按钮；本期不含镜头。
parts.descriptionEn: Lens-release button in a mount-side bore; no lens is included.

parts.descriptionZh: 可拆卸的EN-EL25a产品外形参考件，包含定位肩、端子盖和握持筋；不表示Nikon生产尺寸。
parts.descriptionEn: Removable EN-EL25a product-shaped reference with keyed shoulder, terminal cap, and grip ribs; it does not claim Nikon production dimensions.

parts.descriptionZh: 可拆卸SD卡的示意件，仅用于表达UHS-II卡槽装卸方向，不作为随机配件声明。
parts.descriptionEn: Illustrative removable SD card used only to show UHS-II slot insertion direction; it is not represented as an included accessory.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入独立圆形沉座的MENU按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: MENU button seated in a dedicated circular counterbore.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入独立圆形沉座的播放按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: Playback button seated in a dedicated circular counterbore.

parts.descriptionZh: 嵌入独立圆形沉座的删除按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: Delete button seated in a dedicated circular counterbore.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有中央开孔和四个实体方向瓣的环形方向键。
parts.descriptionEn: Annular direction pad with a true central opening and four physical directional lobes.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于方向键真实中心开孔中的独立OK确认按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: Independent OK button seated in the direction pad's true central opening.

parts.descriptionZh: 带外伸拨杆和红色索引的快门同轴电源环。
parts.descriptionEn: Shutter-coaxial power collar with projecting lever and red index.

parts.descriptionZh: 带周向齿槽并嵌入前握柄凹位的指令拨轮。
parts.descriptionEn: Knurled command dial recessed into the front grip pocket.

parts.descriptionZh: 带可见齿槽并半嵌于后肩的指令拨轮。
parts.descriptionEn: Visibly knurled command dial partially recessed into the rear shoulder.

parts.descriptionZh: 带24个周向防滑齿的顶部模式拨盘参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference top mode dial with 24 visible circumferential knurls.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于独立前壳沉孔中的Fn2功能按钮。
parts.descriptionEn: Fn2 function button seated in a dedicated front-shell bore.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有贯通眼孔的左侧金属肩带环参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference left metal strap eyelet with a true open hole.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有贯通眼孔的右侧金属肩带环参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference right metal strap eyelet with a true open hole.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有双导轨、后桥和内翻压边的ISO 518热靴参考结构。
parts.descriptionEn: ISO 518 reference shoe structure with twin rails, rear bridge, and inward retention lips.

parts.descriptionZh: 独立反光杯、扩散窗和横置闪光管的教学化组合。
parts.descriptionEn: Teaching assembly of separate reflector bowl, diffuser window, and transverse flash tube.

parts.descriptionZh: 底部舱门内侧的滑动锁扣，带独立锁钩和弹片。
parts.descriptionEn: Sliding inner bottom-door latch with separate hook and spring leaf.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于观看孔后的独立圆角目镜片和遮光框。
parts.descriptionEn: Separate rounded eyepiece lens and light mask immediately behind the viewing aperture.

parts.descriptionZh: 带十六个周向齿的侧置屈光度调节轮。
parts.descriptionEn: Side-mounted diopter wheel with sixteen readable circumferential knurls.

parts.descriptionZh: 绝缘触点板包含中央同步触点和四个辅助触点。
parts.descriptionEn: Insulated contact plate with a central synchronization contact and four auxiliary contacts.

parts.descriptionZh: 以铰轴为对象原点的开放式灯头框架，可用于后续弹起动画。
parts.descriptionEn: Open flash-head frame whose object origin is the hinge axis for a later pop-up animation.

parts.descriptionZh: 与灯头对象原点同轴的金属转轴及两端轴承座。
parts.descriptionEn: Metal pivot and two bearing blocks coaxial with the flash-head object origin.

parts.descriptionZh: 关闭屏幕最外侧的独立薄型盖玻璃。
parts.descriptionEn: Independent thin cover glass at the outermost face of the closed display.

parts.descriptionZh: 与框架和盖玻璃保持独立层间距的触控液晶显示层。
parts.descriptionEn: Touch LCD display layer with explicit spacing from both carrier and cover glass.

parts.descriptionZh: 以关闭状态嵌入后壳的3.2英寸级屏幕承载框。
parts.descriptionEn: 3.2-inch-class screen carrier seated in the rear shell in its closed position.

parts.descriptionZh: 贯穿两支铰臂的竖直金属转轴，为后续开屏动画提供同轴基准。
parts.descriptionEn: Vertical metal pivot through both hinge arms, providing the coaxial basis for a later open-screen animation.

parts.descriptionZh: 由机身侧轴套、竖向连杆和下端安装面构成的内侧铰臂。
parts.descriptionEn: Inner hinge arm with body-side hub, vertical link, and lower mounting land.

parts.descriptionZh: 连接关闭屏幕框的外侧铰臂，与内臂共享动画转轴原点。
parts.descriptionEn: Outer hinge arm connecting the closed screen frame and sharing the animation pivot with the inner arm.

parts.descriptionZh: 由周边梁、屏幕开口、铰链口袋和真实按键座组成的中空后壳。
parts.descriptionEn: Hollow rear shell formed from perimeter rails, a screen opening, hinge pocket, and physical button seats.

parts.descriptionZh: 带真实贯通门洞、止口和后接口翻边的左侧薄壁盖板。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin left cover with through door openings, reveals, and rear connector flange.

parts.descriptionZh: 与收腰握柄连续过渡的开放式右侧薄壁盖板。
parts.descriptionEn: Open thin right-side cover flowing into the undercut grip.

parts.descriptionZh: 带收窄前后过渡和电池舱安装面的2毫米底部蒙皮。
parts.descriptionEn: Two-millimetre base skin with tapered transitions and battery-door land.

parts.descriptionZh: 带斜肩、复合EVF隆起与热靴安装面的薄壁顶壳参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin profiled top shell with sloped shoulders, compound EVF hump, and hot-shoe land.

parts.descriptionZh: 带收腰和掌托过渡的1.8毫米中空握柄蒙皮参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Hollow 1.8 mm grip skin with undercut and palm-support transitions.

parts.descriptionZh: 带开放后部、内翻边和55毫米卡口开口的薄壁外壳参考重建。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin open-back reference shell with inner flanges and a 55 mm mount opening.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于外部取景器隆起内部的开放式光学通道，包含三道遮光挡圈。
parts.descriptionEn: Open optical tunnel inside the exterior EVF hump, including three light-control baffles.

parts.descriptionZh: 与目镜分层的微型显示面板、载板和排线插座参考组件。
parts.descriptionEn: Microdisplay reference assembly separated from the eyepiece, with carrier and flex socket.

parts.descriptionZh: 跨越四条信号排线通道的金属压板，带两个实体紧固孔位。
parts.descriptionEn: Metal clamp bridging the four signal-flex routes with two physical fastening locations.

parts.descriptionZh: 从顶部控制板沿肩部折弯至后部连接区的五段排线。
parts.descriptionEn: Five-segment flex routed from the top-control board around the shoulder to the rear connector zone.

parts.descriptionZh: 绕过屏幕铰链并沿后壳内侧转折的控制排线。
parts.descriptionEn: Rear-control flex bending around the LCD hinge and along the inner rear shell.

parts.descriptionZh: 从固定式传感器载板后缘弯折至主板连接区的宽排线。
parts.descriptionEn: Wide flex bending from the fixed sensor carrier edge to the main-board connector zone.

parts.descriptionZh: 从侧置接口板绕至后部连接器的四次转折排线。
parts.descriptionEn: Port-board flex making four controlled bends to the rear connector bank.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于元件前方的冲压式EMI屏蔽罩，带周边加强筋和通风细节。
parts.descriptionEn: Pressed front EMI shield ahead of the components, with perimeter ribs and vent detail.

parts.descriptionZh: 与主板保持间隔的独立后部EMI屏蔽罩。
parts.descriptionEn: Independent rear EMI shield separated from the main board.

parts.descriptionZh: 沿后部上缘布置的薄型折线天线和同轴端子参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin meander antenna and coax terminal routed along the upper rear edge.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于前屏蔽罩与导热垫之间的铜色扩散片和延伸翼片。
parts.descriptionEn: Copper-toned spreader with extension fins between front shield and thermal pad.

parts.descriptionZh: 覆盖次级控制板局部的独立折边射频屏蔽罩。
parts.descriptionEn: Separate folded RF shield can covering a local region of the secondary board.

parts.descriptionZh: 五个具有独立锁扣的排线连接器外壳，用于教学识别接口位置。
parts.descriptionEn: Five flex-connector housings with separate latches for readable interface routing.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有圆角金属壳、中央舌片和可见触点的Type-C SuperSpeed接口。
parts.descriptionEn: Type-C SuperSpeed connector with rounded metal shell, central tongue, and visible contacts.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有不对称梯形开口和触点排的Type-D HDMI接口。
parts.descriptionEn: HDMI Type-D connector with an asymmetric trapezoidal opening and contact row.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有真实圆孔、绝缘筒和后部触点的3.5毫米立体声麦克风接口。
parts.descriptionEn: 3.5 mm stereo microphone input with a true circular opening, insulated barrel, and rear contact.

parts.descriptionZh: 与麦克风口分离的3.5毫米音频输出／遥控复用接口。
parts.descriptionEn: Separate 3.5 mm combined audio-output/remote connector.

parts.descriptionZh: 与扩散片和处理器均分离的柔性导热界面垫。
parts.descriptionEn: Flexible thermal interface pad physically separated from both spreader and processor.

parts.descriptionZh: 主板侧边的狭长轮廓控制板，带独立贴片元件。
parts.descriptionEn: Narrow profiled control board beside the main PCB with separate surface packages.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于顶壳下方的薄型控制板，带开关封装和排线座。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin control board below the top shell with switch packages and a flex socket.

parts.descriptionZh: 承载四种官方公布接口形态的窄型侧置子板，带独立封装和排线座。
parts.descriptionEn: Narrow side daughterboard carrying the four published connector forms, with separate packages and flex socket.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于导热通道后方的影像处理封装，带引脚和导热顶盖。
parts.descriptionEn: Image-processor package behind the thermal path, with visible leads and a heat cap.

parts.descriptionZh: 处理器一侧的独立存储器封装A，用于教学分层。
parts.descriptionEn: Separate memory package A beside the processor for readable teaching-layer separation.

parts.descriptionZh: 与A封装分离布置的存储器封装B。
parts.descriptionEn: Memory package B positioned separately from package A.

parts.descriptionZh: 由控制封装、电感和电容组成的可读电源管理簇。
parts.descriptionEn: Readable power-management cluster of controller package, inductors, and capacitors.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有折边导轨、端部桥和两排触点的UHS-II SD卡槽参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference UHS-II SD slot with folded rails, end bridges, and two readable contact rows.

parts.descriptionZh: 1.0毫米厚多层轮廓主板，带安装焊盘和可读的贴片元件带。
parts.descriptionEn: One-millimetre multi-layer profiled main board with mounting pads and readable surface-component rows.

parts.descriptionZh: 五枚分开的弹片触点与绝缘支座，位于电池托架顶部。
parts.descriptionEn: Five separate spring contacts on an insulating carrier at the top of the battery cradle.

parts.descriptionZh: 由后壁、导轨、前缘和顶部限位组成的开放式电池托架。
parts.descriptionEn: Open battery cradle made from rear wall, guide rails, front lips, and an upper stop.

parts.descriptionZh: 沿托架与电源板边缘转折布线的薄型电源排线，带两端连接器。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin routed power flex following cradle and power-board edges, with connectors at both ends.

parts.descriptionZh: 带键位轮廓、功率封装和连接焊盘的1.0毫米电源板。
parts.descriptionEn: One-millimetre keyed power board with power packages and connector pads.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有卡爪和四个紧固座的Z卡口金属环；内部尺寸为参考重建。
parts.descriptionEn: Z-mount metal ring with bayonet tabs and four fastening lands; internal dimensions are a reference reconstruction.

parts.descriptionZh: 位于金属卡口后方的独立弹性防尘密封圈。
parts.descriptionEn: Separate elastomer dust gasket immediately behind the metal mount.

parts.descriptionZh: 弧形区域内的绝缘触点座，为后续镜头接口保留位置。
parts.descriptionEn: Insulated mount contact carrier positioned for the reserved future lens interface.

parts.descriptionZh: 11枚独立圆头导电针的教学化触点组。
parts.descriptionEn: Teaching representation of an eleven-pin bank with separate rounded conductive contacts.

parts.descriptionZh: 保持卡口与快门组件间光路间隔的开放式支承环。
parts.descriptionEn: Open support ring preserving the optical-path spacing between mount and shutter assembly.

parts.descriptionZh: 由七片薄金属叶片表达的前帘，位于卡口与传感器之间。
parts.descriptionEn: Front curtain represented by seven thin metal lamellae between mount and sensor.

parts.descriptionZh: 与前帘分层对齐的第二组薄金属叶片。
parts.descriptionEn: Second aligned set of thin metal lamellae, physically separated behind the front curtain.

parts.descriptionZh: 包含导轨和驱动罩的开放式纵走焦平面快门框架。
parts.descriptionEn: Open vertical-travel focal-plane shutter frame with guides and drive housing.

parts.descriptionZh: 在快门与盖玻璃之间形成独立周边防尘边界的开放框。
parts.descriptionEn: Open perimeter dust shield forming a separate boundary between shutter and cover glass.

parts.descriptionZh: 与感光面分离的薄型光学盖玻璃参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Thin optical cover-glass reference element separated from the photosensitive plane.

parts.descriptionZh: 23.5×15.7毫米DX有效面尺寸锚点；本参考模型为固定式传感器，不含机身防抖机构。
parts.descriptionEn: 23.5 x 15.7 mm DX active-area anchor; this reference model uses a fixed sensor and contains no in-body stabilization mechanism.

parts.descriptionZh: 围绕预留卡口原点的环形支撑板和四个紧固安装面。
parts.descriptionEn: Annular support and four fastening lands around the reserved mount origin.

parts.descriptionZh: 带冲压式纵横加强筋和三脚架安装区的1.8毫米底部加强板。
parts.descriptionEn: 1.8 mm base reinforcement with formed longitudinal/cross ribs and tripod land.

parts.descriptionZh: 具有边缘焊盘、控制封装和定位切角的传感器载板。
parts.descriptionEn: Sensor carrier PCB with edge pads, controller package, and keyed profile.

parts.descriptionZh: 由环形薄壁梁和四个壳体安装耳组成的开放前内框。
parts.descriptionEn: Open front inner frame made from a thin ring beam and four shell-mount tabs.

parts.descriptionZh: 由纵梁、横梁和掌托薄壁网组成的开放握柄笼架。
parts.descriptionEn: Open grip cage formed by longitudinal rails, cross-members, and a thin palm web.

parts.descriptionZh: 为后续传感器模块保留空间的四边导轨和角部安装柱。
parts.descriptionEn: Four-sided rail with corner bosses reserving the later sensor-module volume.

parts.descriptionZh: 由金属接口、环形安装面与四向加强肋组成的参考三脚架座。
parts.descriptionEn: Reference tripod socket with metal insert, annular land, and four reinforcing webs.

parts.descriptionZh: 左右肩带眼载荷位置的成对安装柱与斜撑参考件。
parts.descriptionEn: Paired reference mounting posts and diagonal webs at the strap-eyelet load paths.

parts.descriptionZh: 围绕55毫米卡口开口布置的开放式环梁、边梁、斜撑和安装柱参考机架。
parts.descriptionEn: Open reference chassis of mount ring, perimeter rails, diagonal webs, and bosses around the 55 mm opening.

拆卸：固定式DX传感器封装
